messages:
anya: quick brainstorm — need a 1-pager + 4-slide narrative for the benchmark webinar next Wed. core hook: "same model, three serving modes" — want to show who wins on latency (p50/p90/p99), $/1k tokens, and tail latency. two chart options and a routing CTA for inbound leads. ideas? :thinking_face:

leo: yes. recommend showing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. chart A: percentile lines (p50/p90/p99) across seq length. chart B: cost waterfall (compute, infra, caching). keep captions ~1 line each.

drew: from infra side we can run a controlled microbench. workload: chat-heavy (70% chat / 30% completion), 512 context avg, 1M tokens sampled. can produce prefix-cache on/off numbers. timeline: I can run today and post numbers.

benchbot: benchmark summary (sample):
hosted -> p50=42ms, p90=120ms, p99=420ms, cost=$0.020/1k tokens
reserved-dedicated -> p50=28ms, p90=88ms, p99=310ms, cost=$0.015/1k
private (optimised) -> p50=25ms, p90=80ms, p99=300ms, cost=$0.018/1k
cache ON -> hosted cost delta -30%, p90 delta -25%

maria: narrative suggestion: lead with "predictable latency, measurable unit economics". 1-pager bullets: 1) three serving modes compared, 2) real numbers + method callout, 3) how caching and batching shift unit cost, 4) CTA -> "run a 2-min eval". routing: tag inbound leads "bench-3way".

sam: routing plan: if lead.tokens_per_week > 10M -> AE flagged + schedule demo; else -> self-serve trial + invite to webinar. I'll add webhook + tag 'bench-3way' and a quick qual question: "main priority: latency | cost | compliance?"

anya: need two short captions for the chart options. draft these:
- Option A (Latency Ladder): "Percentile latency by deployment — lower is more predictable; shows tail behavior at p99."
- Option B (Cost Waterfall): "Per-1k token unit economics broken into compute, infra, and caching benefits."

leo: maybe add a mini-visual for slice comparison: small-multiples for seq lengths (128/512/2048). simple color palette: brand blue for hosted, teal for dedicated, slate for private.

drew: chart spec (quick):
```
chart: "latency_lines"
x: percentile [p50,p90,p99]
y: latency_ms
series: [hosted,dedicated,private]
data_sample:
percentile,hosted,dedicated,private
p50,42,28,25
p90,120,88,80
p99,420,310,300
```

maria: perfect. I'll draft the 1-pager copy and a slide deck outline, assign to design for EOD Tuesday handoff. anya, can you confirm webinar CTA + registration flow so we can wire the inbound play?

anya: confirmed. CTA = "Run a 2-minute benchmark" (link -> evaluation page). webinar RSVP routes to product-led demo for <10M tokens, AE outreach for >10M. thanks all — droplist for design: two chart variants, 1-pager bullets, one CTA button label, routing rules. 

sam: noted. will create the tag + webhook and mock the form with the qual question. will post demo routing flow when ready.

maria: I'll post the draft copy here once done. trying for a first pass in ~6 hours. :calendar:

leo: awesome — if numbers change after full run, we'll update captions. :thumbsup:
